provenance.calibration_units: Stock DT mOhm and percent become internal 0.1 mOhm and permille (both multiplied by 10). Mainline uses micro-ohms and permille.
provenance.stock_output_units: 0.1 mAh; captured signed output multiplied by 100 to obtain microamp-hours
provenance.sample_selection: Eight boundary codes, 32 single-bit words, and 256 Random(6357) 32-bit words, at each of three shunts and three gains.
provenance.scope: Actual stock ARM64 coulomb_get instructions, with register reads, latch pre/post helpers, logging and tracing supplied as fixtures. Confirms packed counter decode, sign, zero encodings, arithmetic/rounding and calibration factors; does not establish electrical behavior, errors, initialization or state of charge.
